text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho, the first leg 
of the Classic races, had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's only the first race of the Classics, 
but if I lose here, I can never become a 
"Triple Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, I can win... Winning is 
natural for me—I have to win!"

Tokai Teio seems to be overly conscious of 
becoming a "Triple Crown Umamusume."
choice_data_list:
Let's focus on showing what you can do at 
your best!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Winning or losing is important 
of course, but above all, I have to give 
it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"My rivals, the crowd, and the Prez too— 
I'm gonna blow them all away and show 'em 
just what kind of race Teio can run!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that suffocating feeling is totally 
gone! All right, I'm heading out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, and one more thing... Even so, I'm 
still aiming to become a 'Triple Crown 
Umamusume'!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to taste that Triple Crown 
glory that Prez seized for herself!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Leave it to the great Teio-sama~!
